mechanisms.conclusion: The three workflows, verifier and feed parser were traced through the actual publication caller. Build workflows reject direct publishing. Promotion validates reviewed source and producer evidence, verifies a fixed payload set and byte digests, rejects divergent existing npm/release assets, and checks a durable version/receipt floor before replacing mutable feed metadata.

The finalizer validates actual payload bytes before generating metadata; the consumer regression invokes electron-updater's real GenericProvider. Promotion tests execute actual workflow Bash with only gh/npm/sleep transport substituted. The finite backoff test requires all ten lookups and nine literal sleep-3 requests in order; simulated elapsed delay is explicitly excluded.

The actual RunHandle is registered during the first synchronous poll, after child acquisition and before the first suspension. Env teardown owns only that Env's weak registrations, starts forced stops and uses one aggregate bounded join budget. The worker control checks both worker PIDs dead and both parent PIDs alive before parent cleanup.

Private retryable/terminal classification was checked against channel admission, route and generation-loss behavior. Retryable failures preserve cancellation, original timeout and RSS watcher lifetime; terminal failure is not a successful empty inventory. The injected AckError tests are Linux-only, use an actual supervisor, actual process identities and liveness before cleanup.
